verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments infrastructure platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions a Finix CLI. It documents an MCP server, used via Claude Code, which is a third-party CLI acting as an MCP client, plus the API, Dashboard and llms.txt. None of these is an official Finix CLI, so the axis applies but is unmet.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
